create-maintenance-table.sql: CREATE TABLE polaris.p3_iceberg.merge_history USING iceberg TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='2','write.merge.mode'='merge-on-read','write.distribution-mode'='hash','write.target-file-size-bytes'='1048576') AS SELECT id, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS v FROM range(12000)
ALTER TABLE polaris.p3_iceberg.merge_history WRITE ORDERED BY id

files-after-1.sql: SELECT content,spec_id,sort_order_id,count(*) files,min(file_size_in_bytes),max(file_size_in_bytes) FROM polaris.p3_iceberg.merge_history.files GROUP BY 1,2,3

data-delete-links-1.sql:
SELECT data.file_path, count(DISTINCT deletes.delete_file_path) AS delete_files
            FROM polaris.p3_iceberg.merge_history.data_files data LEFT JOIN polaris.p3_iceberg.merge_history.position_deletes deletes
            ON data.file_path = deletes.file_path
            GROUP BY data.file_path ORDER BY data.file_path
